title: Use Features and Publish in Chatflow Studio after a publish toast closes
steps: Open Publish, choose Publish Update, and inspect the validation toast over the Studio header.
Click the toast's X, then immediately click the center of the same toast before its fade-out completes.
After the toast is visually gone, click Features, close its panel, and then click Publish.

video_guide.summary: After the toast disappears, Features and Publish respond to clicks again.

chapters.note: The initial publish attempt displays an error toast.
The dismissed toast and publishing popup are no longer visible.
The publishing popup is open and the Features drawer is closed.
